description: Complete restructure of MAKIMA AI chat UI: mobile-first layout with drawer sidebar, proper chat bubbles, code blocks with copy button, quick actions for coding, and model picker. This is a comprehensive rewrite of makima-ai.css and makima-ai.js to match the specifications.
steps: STEP 1 - Rewrite static/css/makima-ai.css completely with the following structure: (A) Mobile layout (<=768px): sidebar as fixed drawer overlay (position fixed, left -100%, width 82vw, max-width 320px, height 100dvh, z-index 1000, transition left 0.3s), when .open left:0. Backdrop overlay (makima-sidebar-overlay) when open. Chat area width 100%, height 100dvh, flex column, overflow hidden. Header ~64px sticky top with hamburger left, avatar+title+ONLINE badge, model picker, settings gear right. Messages area flex:1, overflow-y auto, padding 16px 14px 130px. Input area fixed bottom left:0 right:0, z-index 900, display flex, gap 8px, padding 10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), background dark glass (rgba(5,0,0,0.97) with backdrop-filter). (B) Desktop layout (>768px): sidebar permanent width 260px sticky left. Chat area flex:1. Chat content max-width 820px centered. Input follows chat area not full viewport. Sidebar list scrollable, footer sticky. (C) Chat bubbles: User bubble align right, max-width 76% mobile, background rgba(180,0,0,0.22), rounded 18px, padding 12px 14px. AI bubble: avatar left 30px, bubble right of avatar, max-width 82% mobile, background rgba(0,0,0,0.45), border 1px solid rgba(255,0,40,0.18), rounded 18px, padding 14px 16px, line-height 1.55. No bubble/code overflows screen. (D) Code block: pre max-width 100%, overflow-x auto, white-space pre, border-radius 14px, padding 12px, background rgba(0,0,0,0.45), border 1px solid rgba(255,0,40,0.2). code font-family ui-monospace SFMono-Regular Menlo Monaco Consolas monospace, font-size 13px. Add .makima-code-block-wrap with position relative for copy button positioning.

STEP 2 - Update static/js/makima-ai.js _renderMarkdown function to wrap code blocks in a container div with a COPY button. The copy button must use navigator.clipboard.writeText() only (no API call). Structure: 
...
. After rendering, attach click handlers to all .makima-code-copy-btn buttons that copy the text content of the sibling pre>code element. On success, change button text to 'COPIED!' for 2 seconds then revert.

STEP 3 - Update quick actions in makima-ai.js to match the coding-focused templates: 'Buat kode' -> 'Buatkan kode untuk ', 'Perbaiki UI' -> 'Bantu rapikan UI ini: ', 'Debug error' -> 'Bantu cek error ini: ', 'Jelaskan kode' -> 'Jelaskan kode ini: ', 'Buat prompt' -> 'Buatkan prompt untuk '. Update _makimaQuickActions array and _makimaEmptyStateActions. Quick actions only fill input, do NOT auto-send (this is already the behavior).

STEP 4 - Update model picker in makima-ai.js: The model picker button in the header should show the current provider label with a down-triangle character. The popover shows Auto/Gemini/Groq tabs. Clicking a provider or model only saves to localStorage (already the behavior). Ensure the picker popover CSS positions correctly on mobile (not overflowing right edge).

STEP 5 - Change the input from <input type='text'> to <textarea> in the renderMakimaAI() function in makima-ai.js. The textarea should have: id='makimaInput', class='makima-ai-input', placeholder='Ketik pesan untuk MAKIMA AI...', rows='1', autocomplete='off', autocorrect='off', spellcheck='false'. Add auto-resize behavior: on input event, reset height to auto then set height to min(scrollHeight, 130)px. In CSS: textarea.makima-ai-input with flex:1, min-width:0, min-height:46px, max-height:130px, resize:none. Send on Enter (without shift), newline on Shift+Enter.

STEP 6 - In static/css/makima-ai.css, add the COPY button styles for code blocks: .makima-code-block-wrap position relative. .makima-code-copy-btn position absolute, top 8px, right 8px, background rgba(204,0,0,0.2), border 1px solid rgba(255,0,40,0.3), color #ff6666, font-size 0.65rem, font-weight 700, letter-spacing 1px, padding 4px 10px, border-radius 6px, cursor pointer, text-transform uppercase, z-index 2, transition background 0.2s. Hover: background rgba(204,0,0,0.35).

STEP 7 - Remove the MAKIMA AI page width override from static/css/responsive.css that conflicts. The responsive.css currently has a mobile override that forces .makima-ai-page to width:100%!important and max-width:100%!important. Keep this rule but ensure it does not conflict with the new makima-ai.css mobile layout. Also verify the .view-container override in responsive.css does not affect #viewMakimaAI (which already has its own max-width:100% rule in makima-ai.css).
STEP 8 - Update the SEND button width to exactly 72px (min-width:72px) and flex-shrink:0 to prevent it from being cut off. Ensure on mobile it remains visible and not clipped.
acceptance_criteria: On mobile (<=768px), the sidebar is hidden by default and slides in as a drawer overlay when hamburger is clicked
Chat area takes full viewport width on mobile with no left margin or gap
Header is approximately 64px with hamburger, avatar, title, ONLINE badge, model picker, and settings gear
Messages area scrolls independently with padding-bottom sufficient to not be hidden behind fixed input
Input area is fixed at bottom with safe-area-inset-bottom padding on mobile
Textarea auto-resizes up to 130px max height
SEND button is 72px wide and never gets clipped
Code blocks have max-width:100%, overflow-x:auto, and a COPY button in the top-right corner
COPY button copies code text to clipboard without calling any API
Quick actions match the 5 coding-focused templates specified
Model picker shows Auto/Gemini/Groq and saves to localStorage only
On desktop (>768px), sidebar is permanent at 260px width and chat content is centered with max-width 820px
User bubbles align right, AI bubbles align left with avatar
No horizontal overflow on any screen size
verification: Run 'python -c "import app"' in the project directory to verify no Python import errors
Run 'python -c "from flask import Flask; app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=\"static\"); print(\"OK\")"' to verify Flask can initialize
Verify makima-ai.css has no unclosed braces by running a basic syntax check
Verify makima-ai.js has no syntax errors by running 'node --check static/js/makima-ai.js'
